research_gaps: Absence of a curated, up‑to‑date corpus of monocular depth papers (2023‑2025) with extracted architectural, training, and evaluation details.
Limited cross‑domain generalization of current models; most methods are evaluated on narrow benchmark sets (e.g., KITTI, NYU) and degrade on unseen environments.
Scarcity of real‑time, metric‑scale depth estimators that can be directly integrated into SLAM or AR pipelines.
Under‑explored multimodal/self‑supervised signals (e.g., inertial, event, audio) that could resolve depth ambiguities without expensive sensors.

proposals.name: Comprehensive 2023‑2025 Monocular Depth Benchmark (MD‑Bench2025)
proposals.rationale: Collect, standardize, and annotate all monocular depth papers released between 2023‑2025, extracting model specs, training regimes, and evaluation numbers; supplement with new test suites covering indoor, outdoor, low‑light, and synthetic domains.
proposals.expected_benefit: Provides a reliable reference point for performance comparison, reveals real‑world generalization gaps, and accelerates reproducibility.
proposals.risk: High curation effort; licensing constraints may limit inclusion of certain datasets or code.

proposals.name: Vision‑Depth Foundation Model (VDFM)
proposals.rationale: Train a large‑scale transformer‑based encoder‑decoder on diverse, publicly available video streams (e.g., YouTube‑8M, internet videos) using self‑supervised cues (frame warping, photometric loss) and metric supervision from sparse LiDAR/structure‑from‑motion points.
proposals.expected_benefit: Learns universal depth priors that generalize across domains, reducing the need for per‑dataset fine‑tuning and improving zero‑shot performance.
proposals.risk: Requires massive compute and careful handling of noisy self‑supervision; risk of bias toward dominant scene types in web video corpus.

proposals.name: Multimodal Self‑Supervised Depth Fusion (MSDF)
proposals.rationale: Combine monocular RGB with auxiliary low‑cost sensors (inertial measurement units, event cameras) in a joint self‑supervised loss that enforces geometric consistency across modalities.
proposals.expected_benefit: Helps resolve depth ambiguities in texture‑less or fast‑motion scenes, while keeping runtime suitable for edge devices.
proposals.risk: Additional hardware integration complexity; sensor calibration drift may introduce systematic errors if not properly compensated.
